about: Corrections applied on top of ImpCommEventType.csv when building attendee_upload/event_types.json. Keyed by event type ID. typeName replaces the TypeName; useNotes false stops the EventTypeNotes being used as a course name; extraCourses adds more course names (as they appear in column L of the attendee export) that map to this ID. If the database is corrected, the matching entry here can be removed.

extraCourses: CITI: Introduction to Excel for Improvement eLearning
